definitions.short: the paunch (as a cavity) or first stomach of ruminants
definitions.full: H6896. qebah קֵבָה , suffix קֳבָתָהּ (Kö l.c. compare Ges § 10h ) noun feminine stomach, belly ; — 1 absolute ׳הַקּ fo sacrificial victim, assigned to priest Deut 18:3 , ᵐ5 τὸ ἔνυστρον , i.e. fourth stomach of ruminants (compare Dr), ᵑ9 ventriculum. 2 suffix of woman, apparently more Generally, belly Num 25:8 (P).
